name: Aldric Vane
summary: A sturdy sword-and-board fighter. A good first character: high armour class, simple choices, and no spells to manage.

starting_equipment.option: (a) a martial weapon and a shield

notes.personality: Speaks plainly and keeps every promise, however small.
notes.ideal: Protection. The strong should shield those who cannot shield themselves.
notes.bond: The temple that raised him, and the old priest who taught him to hold a sword.
notes.flaw: Trusts anyone wearing a holy symbol a little too quickly.
notes.backstory: Raised as a temple acolyte, Aldric spent more time in the training yard than at prayer. He left to guard pilgrims on the roads and never quite went back.
